summary.en-US: Connect AI agents to your browser with profile-aware automation and local native messaging.

version.approval_notes: Source is supplied. Build with Bun 1.3.6: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run build:extension:firefox. Native messaging relays explicitly requested browser data to a locally installed host and connected agents. Cloud decision assistance is off by default; screenshot sharing is separately opt-in. Firefox automation uses a user-configured loopback WebDriver BiDi endpoint. No remote executable code or telemetry.

description.en-US: Connect supported AI harnesses to a named browser profile through four compact browsing tools. Includes page search, trusted input, screenshots, approved uploads, and local action memory. Requires the opencode-chromium native host and explicit loopback Firefox launch configuration. Cloud decision assistance is off by default; Luna screenshot sharing is independently opt-in. Desktop Firefox and LibreWolf only.

privacy_policy.en-US: Browser content, URLs, screenshots and requested actions are relayed to your locally installed native host and the AI client you connect. That client may send tool outputs to its configured model provider. Local action memory remains on your device. Optional cloud decision assistance sends bounded page labels to the provider you choose after you enable text sharing. Luna sends at most one bounded screenshot for an ambiguous visual decision only when screenshot sharing is separately enabled. Uploads require explicit approval. This extension has no telemetry and does not collect browsing data independently of requested automation. You can disable assistance, revoke screenshot consent and remove stored credentials from Settings.
